name: model-router
description: Routes each subagent to the cheapest model that fits its task: haiku for web and lookup work, sonnet for building, opus for architecture.

fallback.title: Fallback model
fallback.description: The model a general task runs on when nothing in it says which tier it is.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: rules: keywords only, free. rules+model: a small model labels the tasks the keywords cannot place.

nudge.title: Delegation nudge
nudge.description: Adds a system prompt section asking the main model to delegate self-contained work to subagents so it can be routed.

escalate.title: Escalation handoff
escalate.description: A routed subagent that gets stuck writes a handoff report, and the model one tier up takes the task over with it.
